description: List conversations where the customer wrote last and nobody has replied yet, newest first. This is a backlog of work outstanding, NOT a read/unread state: it is derived from who spoke last, so it clears when a reply is sent from any device and returns if the customer writes again. It is unaffected by whether anyone has opened the chat. A customer who wrote to two of your WhatsApp numbers has one conversation per number: each number still waiting is its own row (whatsapp_channel_id) — reply on THAT number by passing channel_id to the send tool.
name: get_conversations_awaiting_reply
